title: ONCOR opens its Taichung flagship
text: ONCOR expanded beyond Taipei’s Xinyi District with the opening of its Taichung flagship in the city’s Seventh Redevelopment Zone, bringing together karaoke, art, dining and private entertainment.

title: ONCOR 台中店週年派對
text: ONCOR 台中店將於 11 月 20 日舉辦週年派對，現場安排 DJ 演出，並推出限定調酒。
